summary: This bill creates a new tax credit for 25% of expenses for translational research on neurodegenerative diseases and psychiatric conditions, with an aggregate national limitation on the amount of credit that can be claimed each year.

scores.thoughts: This bill creates a new tax credit, which reduces government revenue and can be considered a form of government spending through the tax code, as it incentivizes specific activities (translational research) with public funds. The credit has an aggregate national limitation, indicating a defined amount of foregone revenue.

The bill directly amends the Internal Revenue Code to provide a new tax credit for translational research. This credit reduces the tax liability for eligible entities, effectively lowering their taxes.

By creating a new tax credit, the bill reduces government revenue, which could contribute to an increase in the national debt if not offset by other measures. The bill does not include any provisions for offsetting the cost of the credit.
